Class TextureStore

Namespace: osu.Framework.Graphics.Textures
Assembly: osu.Framework.dll

Provides drawable-ready osu.Framework.Graphics.Textures.Textures sourced from any number of provided sources (via constructor parameter or osu.Framework.Graphics.Textures.TextureStore.AddTextureSource(osu.Framework.IO.Stores.IResourceStore{osu.Framework.Graphics.Textures.TextureUpload})).

public class TextureStore : ITextureStore, IResourceStore<Texture>, IDisposable

ScaleAdjust

Decides at what resolution multiple this osu.Framework.Graphics.Textures.TextureStore is providing sprites at. ie. if we are providing high resolution (at 2x the resolution of standard 1366x768) sprites this should be 2.

AddStore(ITextureStore)

Adds a nested texture store to use during osu.Framework.Graphics.Textures.Texture lookup if not found in this store.

public virtual void AddStore(ITextureStore store)

Parameters

store ITextureStore

The store to add.

Remarks

Of note, nested stores will use their own sources and not include any sources added via osu.Framework.Graphics.Textures.TextureStore.AddTextureSource(osu.Framework.IO.Stores.IResourceStore{osu.Framework.Graphics.Textures.TextureUpload}).

public virtual void AddTextureSource(IResourceStore<TextureUpload> store)

store IResourceStore<TextureUpload>

Remarks

Lookup sources can be implemented easily using a osu.Framework.Graphics.Textures.TextureLoaderStore to provide the final osu.Framework.Graphics.Textures.TextureUpload.
